name: agent-reproducibility-profile
research_question: How far does the accuracy of the retrieval agent move under controlled perturbations of the software environment, the accelerator, the benchmark version, the model version, the implementation, and the temperature - relative to how far it moves when only the random seed changes?

checks.name: code
checks.detail: full-agent at sha256:def10dd51a0902c7, commit 2078734d7f4b with uncommitted changes: the entrypoint file is pinned but the modules it imports are not

checks.name: seeds
checks.detail: 10/10 seeds completed in the thinnest arm

checks.name: statistics
checks.detail: 3/3 comparisons tested, holm-corrected at alpha=0.05, analysis version 1.0

checks.name: artifacts
checks.detail: 93 artifacts, all present and matching their digests

checks.name: provenance
checks.detail: 93 runs recorded (0 failed); every successful run carries its environment, hardware and code identity

checks.name: determinism
checks.detail: Deterministic: 4 executions of an identical run produced identical values on every result metric (accuracy, robustness). latency_ms varied, as expected: those measure the machine rather than the method.

checks.name: reproducibility
checks.detail: Across 7 perturbation axes, the most fragile is 'configuration' (stability 0.05); the geometric mean is 0.51. Changing configuration, dataset, model moves accuracy beyond the tolerance declared for it, so a reproduction differing on those axes should not be expected to match. On implementation the data cannot decide whether the shift stays within tolerance; more runs would be needed to say.

notes: A verdict of PASS WITH GAPS means every check that could be run passed, and some could not be run. The gaps are listed above; they are not failures, but they are not verification either.
